klaim.halaman: Tabel I, h. 3; Tabel II, h. 4 (PDF UPCommons)
klaim.catatan: Urutan HOTA di sel sesuai urutan ByteTrack, SORT, DeepSORT. Apel, YOLOv5x, 128,0 ms banding 15,3 dan 15,4 ms, serta MAPE 7,47% satu minggu sebelum panen cocok. Label M3 tidak tertulis di sel; pelacakan temporal sesuai.

klaim.halaman: Seksi III-A dan Tabel I, h. 3 (PDF UPCommons)
klaim.bukti: These outcomes suggest that the appearance features employed in the DeepSORT algorithm did not significantly contribute to improved fruit tracking performance.
klaim.catatan: Data apel. DeepSORT lebih rendah pada MOTA dan IDF1 serta 128,0 ms banding sekitar 15 ms. Catatan ketelitian: HOTA DeepSORT 0,6824 sedikit di atas SORT 0,6804 (selisih 0,002), tetapi di bawah ByteTrack 0,6894.

klaim.bukti: All experiments are done on the MOTChallenge pedestrian benchmark. [...] The challenge includes three separate tracking benchmarks, namely 2D MOT 2015 [46], MOT16 [54] and MOT17 [54].
klaim.perbaikan: Cite braso2020learning for learned data association in single-camera pedestrian tracking (MOTChallenge: 2D MOT 2015, MOT16, MOT17), not for multi-camera tracking; e.g. 'Outside agriculture, learned association is established for tracking of people and vehicles, both within a single camera [braso2020learning] and across cameras, where datasets with identities across cameras exist [ristani2016performance, chavdarova2018wildtrack, tang2019cityflow].'
klaim.catatan: Asosiasi terpelajar (message passing network) benar, tetapi kajian ini hanya menguji pelacakan pejalan kaki kamera tunggal; tidak ada eksperimen multikamera atau kendaraan. DukeMTMC hanya dipakai untuk melatih fitur ReID.

klaim.bukti: The process of feature extraction was applied based on the colour and texture followed by feature selection using principal component analysis (PCA) [...] Subsequently, an artificial neural network (ANN) with a back-propagation algorithm was applied in the classification process
klaim.perbaikan: followed by colour and texture features selected with PCA and classified with a back-propagation artificial neural network [septiarini2021machine]
klaim.catatan: Fitur warna dan tekstur pada TBS sawit benar. Pengklasifikasinya ANN propagasi balik; sebutan 'classical classifiers' kurang tepat dan mengaburkan beda dengan kalimat sebelumnya yang menyebut 'neural networks'.

klaim.halaman: Abstrak, h. 1; Hasil dan Gambar 9, h. 9
klaim.bukti: As only parts of the tree fruits were visible in the top-view images, linear regression was used to estimate the number of total apples on each tree. An R2 value of 0.80 (MAE: 128.56 and RMSE: 130.56) was obtained.
klaim.catatan: Apel, citra UAV pandangan atas, regresi linear ke jumlah buah dipanen per pohon, R2 0,80 (n = 19 pohon). Penulis sendiri menilai galatnya tinggi (MAE 128,56).
